The '''RO-D-series droid''' was designed and manufactured by [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] to serve as both a [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] and [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] for touring musicians throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Characteristics==
The RO-D was equipped with an array of short-range [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], lethal and non-lethal armaments, dedicated life-protection programming, and pitch-frequency analysis and rhythmic persistence functions. The droids were available in 70 color schemes to match virtually any stage setup.<ref name=":0">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|56|business/13516_4.html|Balmorran Secures Musician Rearmament Contract}}</ref> 

A jack-of-all-trades droid, the RO-D droid could function as a labor droid to help move equipment and set up a stage for a performance and could also act as a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] to repair the same equipment. It also served as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for the performers, and could be used to carry out intellectual property enforcement missions. It cost 14800 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new.<ref name="SGD" />

==History==
In 22 BBY, the [[Melody Fellowship]] partnered with Balmorran Arms to meet the security demands of their touring performers. This move reinforced speculation that the Melody Fellowship sought to seek retribution from [[RetSpan Audionics]] for their [[TribBot mimic series|TribBot mimic droid]], which mimicked the voice patterns of popular Fellowship stars.<ref name=":0" />
